attributes.name: Druva - Administrator Role Changed
attributes.description: Detects changes to the role assigned to a Druva administrator account. Unexpected role changes may provide additional privileges or alter access to protected workloads.
author: Druva

meta.customer_usecase: Detects changes to the role assigned to a Druva administrator account. Unexpected role changes may provide additional privileges or alter access to protected workloads.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE druva.feature == "Admin Event"
    AND druva.event_type == "Administrator Updated"
    AND druva.change.fields == "adminRole"
| EVAL actor = COALESCE(TO_STRING(user.id), TO_STRING(user.name))
| EVAL target_admin = COALESCE(TO_STRING(user.target.email), TO_STRING(user.target.name))
| EVAL event_time = @timestamp
